name: wall-baseboard-simple
description: Per-wall baseboard params (PARITY-BASEBOARD). Verifies the wallBaseboard flag is OFF in Simple and ON in Pro, then renders a custom plan whose walls carry a tall, coloured baseboard override so the skirting strip is clearly visible in 3D (height + colour applied; PlanShell skirting).

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: verify-flag-off-in-simple
steps.failMessage: wallBaseboard should be OFF in Simple mode (pro-tier)

steps.name: verify-flag-on-in-pro
steps.failMessage: wallBaseboard should be ON in Pro mode

steps.name: make-custom-plan-with-baseboards
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); const fp=s.floorPlan; const walls=fp.walls.map(w=>({ ...w, baseboard:{ height:0.3, color:'#b5651d' } })); window.__store.setState({ floorPlan: { ...fp, id:'custom-baseboard', walls } }); })()

steps.name: verify-baseboard-applied
steps.failMessage: baseboard override did not apply to the custom plan walls

steps.name: orbit-view
steps.eval: (() => { const c=window.__three && window.__three.camera; if (c) { c.position.set(6, 7, 11); c.lookAt(5.5, 1.2, 4.3); } })()
